## Lead Pipeline: Global Error Handler
Set this workflow as the default error workflow for the instance (and in each pipeline workflow's settings). Any failed execution is logged to pipeline_errors and posted to the ops Slack channel with the workflow, the node, the error and the execution id, so failures are visible even when nobody is watching n8n.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (workflow, node, error, execution_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'n8n error in ' + $('Format Error').first().json.workflow + ' at node ' + $('Format Error').first().json.node + ': ' + $('Format Error').first().json.error + ' (execution ' + $('Format Error').first().json.executionId + ', ' + $('Format Error').first().json.time + ')' }) }}
